description: Very solid eco and safe opener to get you started on your games.
name: The Racecar Build (DLC RELEASE VERSION)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 5 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to gather 1 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ -> then go to @resource/berrybush.webp@. 1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to build @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@

Queue @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@  when @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ is finished and send between starting @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/sheep.webp@ in case of rush or out on the map to @resource/deer.webp@ @resource/boar.webp@ @resource/berrybush.webp@ if no rush from opp.

Build @landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@ with 5 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ and macro rest of @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (build the landmark opposite your @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ to not take up gather space and try to build it in front of your future @building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@ for the Ryokan buff to be applied to these units.)
@resource/rally.webp@@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and then back to @resource/sheep.webp@ when both @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ are gathered.
Send out @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ if better food spot

2nd @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ on your @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (acts as a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@). Set this building as your main @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@  drop off (Click the "Redirect Yatai" switch in the @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@)
@building_military/stable.webp@ for @unit_sengoku/yari-2.webp@ (insane unit that we want to upgrade with estates for +4 vs cav)
Add @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ if game state allows a bit of greed
@building_military/archery-range.webp@ for @unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@. You need the tier 1 @technology_sengoku/oda_daimyo_1.webp@ for +1 dmg on @unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@
Continue to add more production if the game becomes feudal war. Otherwise add units, do damage, max out on yatai and go heavy feudal or Castle.

description: Classic two Yatai opener for Sengoku to transition smoothly into feudal and either go for agression or fast castle.
name: Sengoku Opener (Beasty opener)
author: Drumz

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ -> @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ (near wood and gold + space for farms) -> @resource/resource_wood.webp@
If you go on @resource/deer.webp@, kill one with your @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@
Bring @resource/sheep.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@ side of the TC
@landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@ easier, @landmark_japanese/koka-township-1.webp@ can be busted if correctly used
Start building @building_military/barracks.webp@ / @building_military/archery-range.webp@ / @building_military/stable.webp@ (near @landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@ if builded) to counter enemy units

Build first @technology_sengoku/hojo_daimyo_1.webp@ or @technology_sengoku/oda_daimyo_1.webp@ or @technology_sengoku/takeda_daimyo_1.webp@ near production building with @resource/resource_stone.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@

description: Build from Beasty's video, transcribed for me to understand it better
name: Feudal Rush (from Beasty) - Copy for me to understand series
author: murtuk

notes: @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 10-13 (leave only 1 on @resource/berrybush.webp@ to build more @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@)
Start 6 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build a @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@as a drop off point (similar to a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@)
When 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ pull whole 6 vills from woodline to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Get @unit_sengoku/daimyo.webp@ and @unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@ if needed. Raid opponent alot and play game out to get castle and lancers. See video for more tips.

description:
Standard opener for team games and some advice on late game army compositions and macro.

Check my other sengoku guides:
- Fast Castle: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/nkm6A61EXQMSG1GnwJ4t
name: Sengoku | Team games guide
author: Jockxtar

notes: Try to also put it in range of @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and move @resource/sheep.webp@ inside the area.

@landmark_japanese/koka-township-1.webp@: If you have good micro. The active providing vision and the @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ can be extremely useful for the entire game if you use them correctly.

@landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@: Provides decent tempo advantage by saving up @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and building time of 6 @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@. The healing is very weak, but still better than nothing. Choose this if you are not confident on your ability to use the @landmark_japanese/koka-township-1.webp@ active skills.
(Even if you don't have the @resource/resource_wood.webp@ yet, move the @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ towards the @resource/resource_stone.webp@)
@building_military/barracks.webp@ make @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend the @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ against early cavalry.
Once you have a good amount of @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, keep an eye on enemy cavalry and try to preentively position them to protect your @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ and teammates economy.
If you lack @resource/resource_food.webp@ for @age/age_3.webp@, buy it at @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ or make @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ upgrades.
@landmark_sengoku/sake_brewery.webp@: Grants a safe source of infinite @resource/resource_gold.webp@. The safest option and a massive economic boost.
Build it in a way that the mats spawn inside @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ aura.
@landmark_japanese/temple-of-equality-2.webp@: Allows picking up @resource/relics.webp@ very early and unlocks 2 very strong upgrades for @unit_sengoku/ikko_ikki.webp@ in @age/age_4.webp@.
Great long term value, but way worse in @age/age_3.webp@
@building_military/barracks.webp@ keep producing @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, but always leaving at least 190 @resource/resource_food.webp@ in reserve.

If you choose @landmark_sengoku/sake_brewery.webp@, move 5 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ and leave 5 of the builders gathering from @landmark_sengoku/sake_brewery.webp@ mats (the other 5 go to @resource/resource_food.webp@).
If you chose @landmark_japanese/temple-of-equality-2.webp@, move all 10 to @resource/resource_food.webp@.

If the first @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ is at the front of your base, build a second one for @building_economy/farm.webp@ at the back. Click 'Redirect Yatai' after it's completed to start buffing it with the @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@

Our @resource/resource_gold.webp@ income is enough to keep a constant production of @unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@ from 3 @building_military/stable.webp@, and since we will be adding @building_economy/farm.webp@, we will eventually have an excess of @resource/resource_food.webp@ that we can use to make @unit_sengoku/yari-2.webp@ to counter @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ or @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@ to counter @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@.
@landmark_sengoku/sword_hunt_statue.webp@: The increase to the @unit_sengoku/daimyo.webp@ attack speed aura makes @civilization_flag/sen.webp@ army insanely strong. By far the best option.
@landmark_japanese/castle-of-the-crow-4.webp@: Good in closed maps with key chokepoints. Overall quite weaker in team games.
Research @technology_sengoku/yatai_farm_gathering.webp@ and put 2 @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ in between your @building_economy/farm.webp@ (make sure they don't overlap).
Then you can consider researching elite upgrades for @unit_sengoku/yari-2.webp@, @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@ and @unit_sengoku/tanegashima_ashigaru-3.webp@
@unit_sengoku/tanegashima_ashigaru-3.webp@ are a good addition to the army since they are ranged units and benefit a lot from the bonus attack speed of @unit_sengoku/daimyo.webp@

@unit_sengoku/ikko_ikki.webp@ are also a great addition to the frontline, since they can heal the whole army every time they attack and can become quite tanky with upgrades, and they don't receive bonus damage from either @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ or @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@.

Last but not least, research @technology_japanese/oda-tactics-4.webp@ and @technology_military/serpentine-powder.webp@ as well as @technology_sengoku/samurai_yumi.webp@and @building_japanese/buddhist-temple-3.webp@ upgrades.

name: Beasty's NEW Sengoku Build Order - Belkins
author: Belkins

notes: Build @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ on gold (and wood if possible). @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@
Buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@to build @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@. Put it on the @resource/boar.webp@ or between @resource/deer.webp@+@resource/berrybush.webp@ if closer.

Buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@to build 2nd @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@. Put it on the @resource/deer.webp@. If @age/age_1.webp@ rushed spent wood to build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on gold instead.
If opponent tries to buid @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ near your gold. Build a second @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on other side. Then go triple @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ into FC.
Buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@to build 3rd @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@.  Put it between @resource/sheep.webp@+@resource/berrybush.webp@ near your @building_economy/town-center.webp@.
Then when you have 75-80 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ move vils from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Age up with 3 @resource/resource_gold.webp@+ 1 new @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@. @landmark_japanese/koka-township-1.webp@ if you will use it. Other wise @landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@ (It will also save wood for FC all in).
Remacro 8 @resource/resource_food.webp@ vils except one, to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@.

Age up vils and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ . Build @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@ or @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@ with 2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@.

Build @technology_sengoku/takeda_daimyo_1.webp@/@technology_sengoku/oda_daimyo_1.webp@ depending on if you went @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@ or @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@. And queue @unit_sengoku/daimyo.webp@.

@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ and when you have too much food, rally onto the @resource/resource_gold.webp@ for @age/age_3.webp@ or onto the @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build more @building_military/stable.webp@/@building_military/archery-range.webp@

Build a @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ on the @resource/resource_stone.webp@. Research @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@/@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ and @technology_japanese/tatara-1.webp@

description: Simple Sengoku Daimyo Build Order by Beasty
name: Simple Sengoku Daimyo - Beasty
author: Niki45nk

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ builds @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ 2 tiles from @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, then goes to @resource/deer.webp@
Make 2 @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ from @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ and send to @resource/boar.webp@ (or other @resource/resource_food.webp@ sources)

When you have 2 @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ and 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, all @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ go to @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@
If against Knight Civ, make @building_military/stable.webp@ + @building_military/barracks.webp@ into @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ + @unit_sengoku/yari-2.webp@

When 150 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, 1 @resource/deer.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ builds Hojo Daimyo Estate near @building_military/barracks.webp@/@building_military/archery-range.webp@/@building_military/stable.webp@

When @resource/deer.webp@ are depleted, send @resource/deer.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ + @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/berrybush.webp@/@resource/boar.webp@
Now you can either Feudal Rush the opponent or Age-up
